_comment: Ten Hebrew recipes for POST /parse-recipe (issue #71), resolved against the seeded MVP catalog (data/*.yaml). Written by hand for the test, not copied from a site. 'html' recipes are served by a fake fetcher. Expected items: [canonical display name, quantity, unit, needs_confirmation]; quantity counts packs of the canonical's typical pack size (soft_attrs.pack_size), or kg when unit is kg. Unit conversions use the estimated tables in smartcart_catalog/recipe.py.
